details.description: Qwen3.7-Plus is a closed, proprietary chat model in Alibaba's Qwen "Plus" tier, listed in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's current text-generation model catalog. Fireworks AI, which hosts it outside Alibaba's own infrastructure, describes it as "Alibaba's latest flagship closed model" and its hosted listing shows support for image input and function calling. Alibaba does not publish parameter counts or benchmark scores for this closed model; Fireworks AI's listing states it is not a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model.
advantages: Supports function calling (tool use), per Fireworks AI's hosted model page.
Currently listed in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's text-generation model catalog alongside Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-Flash, indicating an actively maintained offering.
disadvantages: Closed, proprietary model: Alibaba does not publish parameter counts or independently verifiable benchmark scores for it; Fireworks AI's listing states it is not a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model.
Hosted outside Alibaba's own infrastructure only through Fireworks AI and Together AI, per their listings, so its capabilities could not be independently verified beyond those hosted pages.
use_cases: General-purpose text generation and chat, per its listing in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's text-generation catalog.
Tool-calling and function-calling workflows, per its Fireworks AI hosted listing.

notes: Bud's catalog lists this target as text-only (text_input/text_output), but Fireworks AI's own listing for Qwen3.7-Plus shows image/vision input support; kept the catalog's modality as authoritative per the research prompt. Together AI's serverless-models documentation does not corroborate vision support: its chat-models table has no vision/image column, and Qwen3.7-Plus is not listed in Together's separate vision-models section (only Qwen3.5 9B, Minimax M3 and Kimi K3 are), so the earlier claim that Together also shows image input was removed. Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's own per-model detail page is a JavaScript console app that returned no readable content via automated fetch, so this entry relies on Model Studio's general model-catalog listing page (which names and categorizes this model) plus the two hosts' pages.
